news.title: Kin Insurance opens its quoting to ChatGPT agents

bullets: Own the roadmap for migrating the current quoting foundation and customization of Kin’s multi-channel quoting capabilities
Partner with engineering, design, and stakeholders to take quoting capabilities from prototype through production rollout
Orchestrate dependencies and timelines across a number of teams (both tech and stakeholders), surfacing risks and trade-offs early
Drive incremental improvements to the quoting experience for both agents and customers that reduce time to quote and friction to bind
Lead experiments in customized and cross-channel quoting experiences, setting the hypotheses, success metrics, and next steps based on the results
Dig past the first request to the real decision a pricing, underwriting, actuarial, or claims team is trying to make, asking why enough times to get there
Enable the data products behind those decisions, from the datasets that feed a rate review to the views a claims team works from
Connect data across the systems that hold it, including Snapsheet and Xactimate for claims and vendor loss modeling from RMS and Verisk, so a change in any of them is understood…
Build supporting datasets proactively, ahead of the questions, so teams can dig into a metric or a problem without waiting on a new pull
Scope and deliver data products in partnership with data engineering
